decisions.reason: The candidate already has a complete same-message MODIFY recording the selected LED part number, model, package, and RGBW format.
Specifying an LCSC part number for the LED BOM does not establish availability, cost, or a change to the existing component-sourceability policy.
The LED BOM entry does not change the requested manufacturer-order review or ordering-assistance obligations.
Selecting the LED component does not entail any change to KiCad project portability or library resolution.

The selected SK6812MINI-E model may bear on the unresolved supply-voltage and level-shifter question, but the source does not explicitly decide those electrical requirements and separate power control leaves multiple plausible interpretations.
The numeric package dimensions only create incidental retrieval overlap and do not affect I2C pull-ups, series resistors, placement, speed, or cable length.
The selected LED model and package do not necessarily change the switched rail's voltage, loads, GPIO, or independent sensor-control topology.
The LED component model is unrelated to the established ESP32-S3 module selection and breakout requirement.
The LED BOM entry does not change the AXP2101 battery, USB, VMID, VSYS, or normal-operation power path.
Selecting the LED part does not alter the required standby cutoff behavior, control GPIO, zero-current target, or separate LED power control.
The LED part specification contains no GPIO assignment or module-pin compatibility decision.
The LED component selection does not change the sensor board's connector inventory, pinouts, sensor modules, or supply interfaces.
